name: IBPS PO/MT

source.title: Notification CRP PO/MT-XVI, Annexure III: Guidelines for Scanning and Upload of Documents

uploads.label: Photograph
rules: Recent passport-style colour photo, 4.5 cm x 3.5 cm.
Look straight at the camera with a relaxed face; no harsh shadows or red-eye.
No caps, hats or dark glasses. Religious headwear is allowed if it does not cover the face.
If you wear glasses, there must be no reflections and your eyes must be clearly visible.

uploads.label: Signature
rules: Sign on white paper with a black ink pen.
Must match the signature you give at the exam, or you are disqualified.

uploads.label: Left thumb impression
rules: On white paper with black or blue ink.
Without a left thumb, use the right thumb, then a finger, as the notification describes, and name the finger used in the uploaded image.

uploads.label: Handwritten declaration
rules: In your own handwriting, in English only, black ink on white paper.

Text: "I, __________ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."

uploads.label: SSC / SSLC / 10th standard or equivalent certificate
Certificate of limitation to write, for candidates who need a scribe (Clause J (ix))

notes: A live photograph is also captured in the form by webcam, or by scanning a QR code with a phone, in addition to the uploaded photo.
The portal will not let you continue until the photo and signature meet the specification.
Scan at a minimum of 200 dpi in True Colour.
Checked against the PO/MT notification only. Clerk, RRB and SO notifications have their own annexures.
